answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 7042 Country: India Title: What about killing the animals in Islamic sharia for non vegetarian food please clearify this qustion? Question: What about killing the animals in Islamic sharia for non vegetarian food please clearify this qustion? Answer ID: 7042 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 807/807=M/1429) If the lawfully eatable animals were slaughtered as per the method prescribed by Shariah then it is lawful to eat it. It is allowed to slaughter or hunt the lawful animals for food according to Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
